pages.name: Bifang
pages.text: The Sun Fields' rare elite: a one-legged fire crane, 80 health and 6 armor, untouched by fire. There is never more than one within 64 blocks. Its peck sets you alight, and every 5 seconds or so it breathes three fireballs at a foe 4 to 14 blocks off.

A Bifang drops 1 to 2 (more with Looting).$(br2)$(l)Fuel$(): it burns twice as long as a bucket of lava.$(br)$(l)Thrown$(): right-click to throw it; where it lands a ring of flame bursts, 6 damage and five seconds alight to all within 3.5 blocks but you. It sets no blocks on fire.

pages.name: Thunder Firefly
pages.text: It drifts over the Thunder Grove at night and in rain, its tail bright with stored lightning. It does no harm. Use a glass bottle on one to take it, and you have a Thunder Firefly Bottle.

$(li)$(l)Set down$(): use it on a block for a lamp of light 12 that now and then throws a spark$(li)$(l)Thrown$(): it shatters in a shock, 4 damage and two seconds of slowness to all within 2.5 blocks but you, and the firefly flies free$(li)$(l)Let go$(): use it while sneaking to free the firefly and keep the bottle

pages.name: Golden-Bell Sparrow
pages.text: A small white-and-gold bird of the Blade Wastes with a bell at its throat. Hurt, or approached by a player who is not sneaking, it bursts up with a ring of its bell and glides down a few blocks off. It drops 0 to 2 Golden-Bell Feathers.

$(l)Whistling Arrows$(): flint, a stick and a Golden-Bell Feather make 4. In flight one whistles and bends toward the nearest hostile creature within 16 blocks in a cone of about 60 degrees ahead, never faster than it was shot.

pages.name: Netherlamp Fish
pages.text: A dark fish of the Tide Sea's depths with a lamp hung before its mouth on a stalk. It flees like any fish and can be taken in a water bucket. It always drops a Netherlamp Sac.
$(l)Netherlamp$(): eight iron nuggets round a Netherlamp Sac. A lantern of light 15 that can be placed under water. Held in either hand, it gives night vision under water.
